answer: The fee is charged through a nadir debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the trellis totals, and the jetty anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 19 units per epoch, sustaining 360 aliases for 43 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
